# Test fixtures

- `harbor-lantern-minutes.pdf`: 3 text pages of minutes from the fictional "Harbor Lantern Society".
- `mixed-scanned.pdf`: page 1 text, page 2 drawing only (no text layer, like a scan), page 3 text.

All text is synthetic and made up; any resemblance to real people or organizations is coincidental.
Both PDFs are generated by `node scripts/make-fixtures.mjs` (deterministic, no dependencies).

`fixtures.expected.json` records page counts, no-text pages and chunk counts as produced by the
current `pageIndex` and `chunker`; `test/unit/pdf/chunker.test.ts` and `pageIndex.test.ts` assert
them. Update it only after an intentional change to indexing or chunking.

License: the fixture PDFs, their text and `fixtures.expected.json` are dedicated to the public domain
under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
